game_name: Paewang Jeonseol / Legend of a Warrior (Korean censored Samurai Shodown IV)
general_issues: Select samsho4k.zip. Keep parent archives and neogeo.zip beside it. Offline physical DIP switches are in Game Settings. Use Test Menu for the original game soft-DIP options. TPO assigns all players and cabinet switches automatically. Up to 2 computers.
